## Constants

ClientTimeout says the maximal time a client is blocked from playing the game until a respawn happens\.

```go
const ClientRespawnTime = 5 * time.Second
```

ClientShutdownTime is the upper limit for a client to remove the connection\, before forced termination\.

```go
const ClientShutdownTime = 1 * time.Second
```

ClientTimeout says the maximal time a client may not have an active connection to the system\, before beeing removed from it\.

```go
const ClientTimeout = 5 * time.Second
```

ClientTimeoutTime is the upper limit for a client to reconnect after a undesired connection loss\.

```go
const ClientTimeoutTime = 5 * time.Second
```

```go
const (
    // MaxClientCommand is the maximal length of the opcode data slice
    // Attention this value has to be changed once the protocol changes.
    MaxClientCommand int = 25
)
```

QueueSize is the max buffer size of the queue

```go
const QueueSize = 10
```

## Variables

```go
var (
    // ErrClientWorkersAlreadyActive is the error that as the name implies
    // tries to show to the caller that the respective client already
    // has a running send and receiver pump thread.
    ErrClientWorkersAlreadyActive = errors.New("the client workers are already active")

    // ErrNoBytesRead is the error returned in case that the received
    // byte count it zero.
    ErrNoBytesRead = errors.New("empty package received")

    // ErrClosedConnection is the error returned in case of
    // that the connections is closed by the client.
    ErrClosedConnection = errors.New("the client closed the connection")
)
```

```go
var (
    // ErrQueueClosed is the error that is returned, if the
    // queue invariant is not fulfilled.
    ErrQueueClosed = errors.New("queue is closed")
    // ErrQueueIsDraining is the error returned while the queue
    // is draining.
    ErrQueueIsDraining = errors.New("queue is already draining")
    // ErrQueueEmpty is the error returned, when the queue is
    // empty so that there is nothing else to drain.
    ErrQueueEmpty = errors.New("queue is empty")
)
```

ErrAlreadyTimeout is the error returned once a timeout would be repeatedly timeout\.

```go
var ErrAlreadyTimeout = errors.New("this client is already timed out")
```

### func \(\*ClientManager\) [AddClient](<https://github.zhaw.ch/raycasters/server/blob/master/room/client/clientmanager.go#L200>)

```go
func (manager *ClientManager) AddClient(meta ClientMeta, queue ClientQueue, timeoutMessanger func(id uint8) ClientTimer) error
```

AddClient will add a new client to the manager\, if the client has once before been added\, then the previous connection will be replaced\, as per definition a client can only reconnect\, over a new connection\. If the client UUID already has a working connection\, an error will be returned\.

As to not have to rebuild an unneeded ClientTimer the function is only called in the case that there is a new client added\.

If there is an invariant due to some incorrect programming then this function will panic\.

## type [ConnectionStatus](<https://github.zhaw.ch/raycasters/server/blob/master/room/client/client_data.go#L14>)

ConnectionStatus is an enum type used for showing the state of the

```go
type ConnectionStatus uint
```

```go
const (
    //Active represents the connections state, where
    // there is nominal client server interactions.
    Active ConnectionStatus = iota
    // Registered represents the state after
    // the connections, was added to the user.
    Registered
    // Timeout represents the state that happens
    // once there are connections errors between
    // client and server. It shows a temporary
    // waiting state between setting the client
    // offline and still being connected, giving
    // a change to reconnect to the server.
    //
    // Attention this state also means that the
    // previous connections is dead.
    Timeout
    // Abandoned is a state which the client is
    // set after an unsuccessful timeout.
    Abandoned
    // ShuttingDown is a temporary state where
    // the client connection is in while
    // waiting for the workers to shutdown
    ShuttingDown
    // Offline is the state, where the client
    // awaits deletion.
    Offline
)
```

